description: A car manufacturer ships their cars on large and small planes. A large plane can carry 30 cars while a small plane can carry 10 cars. Since large planes cause more pollution, the number of large planes must be less than the number of small planes. If the manufacturer wants to deliver at least 300 cars, find the minimum number of planes that can be used.

CapacityLarge.definition: Number of cars a large plane can carry

CapacitySmall.definition: Number of cars a small plane can carry

MinCars.definition: Minimum number of cars to deliver

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of planes used (large and small combined) to deliver at least 300 cars"

constraints.description: The total number of cars delivered by large and small planes must be at least MinCars
The number of large planes used must be less than the number of small planes used
The number of large planes and small planes used must be non-negative integers
